Container.Name: ShareDrive-Web
Container.Overview: ShareDrive React frontend and nginx gateway. Build sharedrive-web:unraid locally first. Start ShareDrive-Backend before this container. Caddy in unraid/compose.infrastructure.yml publishes HTTP on port 8088 by default; change this WebUI URL if you change HTTP_PORT. No direct nginx port is published. Local images have to be rebuilt for updates; do not enable registry auto-updates for this template.
